purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Pare

queries.query: Pare Kediri Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Found LokaGeo Kabupaten Kediri, a local geospatial portal describing verified WebGIS and open spatial-data catalog coverage for Kediri Regency, and the official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal. No public Pare/Kediri cadastral parcel feature endpoint was established.

queries.query: Pare Kediri peta bidang tanah kadaster GIS resmi pertanahan
queries.result: Found local Kediri geospatial catalog and ATR/BPN materials describing land/parcels generally. The inspected public catalogs exposed administrative/thematic layers and selected datasets for other areas, not a public Pare parcel response.

registryEvidence.basis: LokaGeo Kabupaten Kediri presents itself as the official local geospatial data/information portal and exposes a public WebGIS/catalog for Kabupaten Kediri. This establishes a local map/data custodian, but not an open cadastral parcel layer.

officialSources.observation: Portal states it is the official Kabupaten Kediri geospatial data/information portal, with verified WebGIS and integration with BIG, ATR/BPN, Kemendagri, and Kominfo.
Public catalog offered administrative boundaries and thematic datasets in SHP/GeoJSON formats; no cadastral parcel dataset was listed in the inspected catalog.
Official ATR/BPN ATLAS landing page; current public catalog exposed seven datasets, including land-office locations, selected wakaf layers, and LBS, but no Pare/Kediri cadastral parcel layer.
Official Kota Kediri page documents complete-city status for Kota Kediri; Pare is in Kabupaten Kediri, so this is contextual and not evidence of Pare coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: LokaGeo Kabupaten Kediri local geospatial portal/catalog and national ATR/BPN ATLAS catalog.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The local catalog and national catalog were inspected through their public pages/API. No city-bounded cadastral parcel feature response with a safe native identity was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: Pare's cadastral data may be available through an authenticated, non-indexed, or separately administered ATR/BPN/Kediri workflow. A catalog omission or a single exact-point miss would not establish citywide absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or owner/address/titleholder fields were used.
